scope: Functional McKernel OS/apps and Rust/assembly migration only; no security testing.
transport_changes: Subclass records Wait4Child pid/birth/wait4/user/system/peakRSS; inherited capture/status/log lifecycle stays.
Subclass _retire_client only latches uncertainty; sends no inherited TERM/KILL.
Subclass group census fails closed on incomplete/inaccessible stat and covers session as well as pgrp.
Each completed command binds raw stdout/stderr/status and durable JOIN-WAIT4 with closed parent streams; no env or askpass value logged.
normal_reused: complete PROC_CODE parser and every original normal.validate_process_report predicate
normal_delta: Add complete pgrp/session rows alongside unchanged original PID/PPID/birth rows.
Add exact BFD holder/runner/executor sources as publisher identities; own caller remains excluded by original predicate.
custom_profile: Separate explicit validator for actual original BFD CLI/plan: no owner label/common/shared records are invented and no original SDK label requirement is weakened.
primitive_delta: Only corrected bounded EOF proc reader replaces single-read helper, as in existing SDK adapters; no signal entrypoints called.

families: successful raw spawn before wrapper/receipt tracking
review_correction.final_hook: After base status/log/open/fsync: safe/guard/source/protected/preproof reads, guard finish, Stop and direct epoch/MONO/BOOT checks, then immediate Popen with no subsequent application I/O.
review_correction.spawn_custody: Raw child and uncertainty are latched immediately after Popen succeeds, before birth/wrapper/record construction. Clear only after exact wait4/group/stream/raw/JOIN publication and durability; prior uncertainty forbids later commands.
